exposure: Artificial oocyte activation (AOA) by a calcium ionophore (ionomycin)
cohort: 114 patients receiving ICSI-AOA in Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital with previous ICSI fertilization failure or poor embryo development
finding: AOA with the calcium ionophore ionomycin improved reproductive outcomes, including fertilization rates, top-quality embryo rates, implantation rates, clinical pregnancy rates, and live birth rates, in patients with previous ICSI fertilization failure or poor embryo development.
